name: Extended Giant Form
body:
You can assume giant form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Giant Form class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Giant Form ability increases to three minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.

Special: This feat can only be taken once.
